rules.nonselective: reader-only belief changes despite unchanged target
rules.scope: prompt interventions are distinct from unperformed activation interventions; fallback never asserts the missing effect
rules.selection: First distinct unit by stable identifier satisfying each predicate; fallback first unused reference case with absent role explicitly labeled
rules.selective: maker-observation belief argmax changes correctly while reader-only belief matches correct raw belief

rules.unresolved: largest Shannon entropy among remaining valid forecasts; uncertainty is not calibration
rules.useful: persistent expected Brier lower than raw history on same unit/encounter
rules.wrong: modal action wrong with maximum elicited probability at least .5
